title: Saudian Lamb Kebabs
description: Grilled lamb skewers infused with the flavors of the Arabian Peninsula.
instructions: 2) Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3) In a small bowl, mix together honey, saudian spice blend, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
4) Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the lamb cubes.
5) Grill the kebabs for 5-6 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
6) Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
7) Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
